Ava (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — leaving this thread open for travel/offsite/desk questions. I'll compile answers and post a short FAQ later. @here :wave:
sree (Eng): Thanks! Quick q — if I book a multi-city personal stopover during a work trip (e.g., adding a weekend), which parts are reimbursable?
Ava (People Ops): Short version: work-related legs are reimbursable, personal stopovers are not. If flights are cheaper with the stopover included, pick the lower-cost itinerary and attach a price-comparison screenshot. Tag the expense `personal-stopover` and add a note. Example expense note format:
```
Trip: SFO -> LHR (work) 
Stopover: LON weekend (personal) 
Reimbursable: SFO -> LHR + LHR -> SFO cost difference claimed
Attachments: price-comparison.png, itinerary.pdf
```
jamie (Office Admin): For offsites we now have a short exceptions form if you need family support or extra nights. Link will be in the FAQ but ping me for immediate cases. (Also: we can pre-book airport transfers for teams of 5+.) :airplane:
micah (Sales): International visa support q — does company cover expedite fees and agency processing?
Ava (People Ops): Yes, standard business visa processing and expedite fees are covered. Passport renewal is personal. For agency fees, use expense code `TRVL-VISA` and include the invoice.
Ethan (CEO): Heads-up — Q3 offsite budget is tighter. Prioritize customer-facing and cross-functional product planning. If you think your team needs an exception, DM @Ava or me with the business case.
Ava (People Ops): Desk booking rollout: starting June 2 we’re rolling DeskBook (calendar plugin) for hybrid hoteling. To reserve: use the plugin or ping `#desk-booking`. Hot-desk allotment guidance: typically 3 days/week per person, team caps at 10 desks/day by default. Long-term desk (4+ days/wk) requests go through the long-term-request form.
jamie (Office Admin): Also: flexible storage lockers will be available in Hub A. If you need special equipment (monitor, cable), fill the equipment request in the same form.
sree (Eng): What about commuting stipend for people who come to the office regularly? Are we phasing that out?
Ava (People Ops): No phase-out. Commuting stipend remains for folks with 3+ in-office days/week. We're migrating existing transit-credit users to the new stipend automatically this month — you'll see it on payroll notes.
micah (Sales): Any guidance on corporate apartments vs hotels for offsites (cost and liability)?
jamie (Office Admin): Prefer vetted corporate apartments for teams >5 staying 4+ nights. Submit an estimated cost and occupancy and we'll pre-approve. Use tag `offsite-lodging`. For vendor recommendations DM me.
calendar-bot: Reminder: Offsite expense cutoff for Q2 is 1873600000 (unix ts). :bell:
alex (Eng): Are dependents covered for the family travel stipend?
Ava (People Ops): We cover childcare during mandatory working sessions up to $150/day with receipts. For partner travel, request an exception (business-case required).
micah (Sales): Safe-travel policy — who do we notify in emergencies while abroad?
Ava (People Ops): Contact People Ops and Security immediately. Security's emergency line and country-specific guidance are in the travel handbook — we'll add quick-check-in steps for higher-risk geos.
jamie (Office Admin): I'll consolidate these Qs into a short FAQ doc and drop it in `#resources/offsite-travel` and the handbook. If I miss anything, add replies here and I'll fold them in. :memo:
sree (Eng): thanks!
Ethan (CEO): Thanks everyone — appreciate the thoughtful questions. We'll publish the summarized FAQ and update the offsite playbook by end of week. :rocket:
